summary: AIR Global PLC, a Dubai-domiciled foreign private issuer (tobacco products, NYSE-listed), furnished a 6-K disclosing a new capital return framework established October 15, 2026. The board approved a US$0.28 annual cash dividend for fiscal 2027, paid quarterly beginning with Q1 2027 results in May 2027, plus a progressive dividend policy and up to US$100 million of share repurchases through December 2029 under Rule 10b-18. Funding comes from equity free cash flow; net leverage targeted at or below 2.0x by December 2027. Watch execution pace, buyback utilization, leverage trajectory and free-cash-flow coverage.
